+    def notify_role_switch_peers(self, timeout: float = 5.0) -> None:
+        """Wait for known peers to forget this idle manager before teardown."""
+        if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
+            with self._socket_lock:
+                retired = self._retired_decode_peers.copy()
+            peers = {
+                (peer.endpoint, peer.dst_port)
+                for peer in list(self.decode_kv_args_table.values())
+                if NetworkAddress(peer.endpoint, peer.dst_port).to_tcp() not in retired
+            }
+        else:
+            with self.connection_lock:
+                peers = {
+                    (info["rank_ip"], info["rank_port"])
+                    for infos in self.connection_pool.values()
+                    for info in infos
+                }
+                # If only some P peers retire us before notification fails,
+                # staying in D must still force registration on the next use.
+                self.connection_pool.clear()
+        if not peers:
+            return
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        request_id = uuid.uuid4().bytes
+        with self._peer_cache_condition:
+            self._peer_cache_request_id = request_id
+            self._peer_cache_pending = peers.copy()
+        try:
+            message = [
+                PEER_CACHE_INVALIDATE,
+                request_id,
+                self.disaggregation_mode.value.encode("ascii"),
+                self.local_ip.encode("ascii"),
+                str(self.rank_port).encode("ascii"),
+            ]
+            # Fan out without waiting between peers or blocking on a full queue.
+            for ip, port in peers:
+                endpoint = NetworkAddress(ip, port)
+                if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE:
+                    sock, lock = CommonKVReceiver._connect(
+                        endpoint.to_tcp(), endpoint.is_ipv6
+                    )
+                else:
+                    sock = self._connect(endpoint.to_tcp(), is_ipv6=endpoint.is_ipv6)
+                    lock = self._socket_send_locks[endpoint.to_tcp()]
+                with lock:
+                    sock.send_multipart(message, flags=zmq.NOBLOCK)
+            with self._peer_cache_condition:
+                if not self._peer_cache_condition.wait_for(
+                    lambda: not self._peer_cache_pending,
+                    timeout=max(0, timeout - (time.monotonic() - started)),
+                ):
+                    raise TimeoutError(
+                        f"Peers did not acknowledge cache invalidation: {sorted(self._peer_cache_pending)}"
+                    )
+        finally:
+            with self._peer_cache_condition:
+                self._peer_cache_request_id = None
+                self._peer_cache_pending.clear()
+
+    def handle_peer_cache_invalidation(self, msg: List[bytes]) -> bool:
+        if not msg or msg[0] not in (PEER_CACHE_INVALIDATE, PEER_CACHE_ACK):
+            return False
+        try:
+            if msg[0] == PEER_CACHE_ACK:
+                _, request_id, ip, port = msg
+                with self._peer_cache_condition:
+                    if request_id == self._peer_cache_request_id:
+                        self._peer_cache_pending.discard(
+                            (ip.decode("ascii"), int(port))
+                        )
+                        self._peer_cache_condition.notify_all()
+                return True
+            _, request_id, role, ip, port = msg
+            ip, port = ip.decode("ascii"), int(port)
+            endpoint = NetworkAddress(ip, port)
+            ack = [
+                PEER_CACHE_ACK,
+                request_id,
+                self.local_ip.encode("ascii"),
+                str(self.rank_port).encode("ascii"),
+            ]
+            if (
+                role == b"prefill"
+                and self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE
+            ):
+                with self.connection_lock:
+                    stale_keys = [
+                        key
+                        for key, infos in self.connection_pool.items()
+                        if any(
+                            (info["rank_ip"], info["rank_port"]) == (ip, port)
+                            for info in infos
+                        )
+                    ]
+                    for key in stale_keys:
+                        del self.connection_pool[key]
+                # Remove the socket from the cache before ACK can release P.
+                # Its final frame still uses the already-established connection.
+                CommonKVReceiver.disconnect_endpoint(
+                    endpoint.to_tcp(), final_message=ack, is_ipv6=endpoint.is_ipv6
+                )
+            elif (
+                role == b"decode"
+                and self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+            ):
+                # Keep backend registrations for normal teardown, but do not
+                # await departed D workers during a later P role switch.
+                with self._socket_lock:
+                    self._retired_decode_peers.add(endpoint.to_tcp())
+                sock = self._connect(endpoint.to_tcp(), is_ipv6=endpoint.is_ipv6)
+                with self._socket_send_locks[endpoint.to_tcp()]:
+                    sock.send_multipart(ack, flags=zmq.NOBLOCK)
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("Peer invalidation role does not match receiver")
+        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError, zmq.ZMQError):
+            logger.exception("Failed to handle peer cache invalidation")
+        return True

+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode

@@ -88,6 +89,169 @@ def _fetching_receiver(connection_pool):
 
 
 class TestReceiverConnectionPool(CustomTestCase):
+    def _transport_manager(self):
+        manager = _manager()
+        manager._zmq_ctx = zmq.Context()
+        self.addCleanup(manager._zmq_ctx.destroy, linger=0)
+        manager.local_ip = "127.0.0.1"
+        manager.server_socket = manager._zmq_ctx.socket(zmq.PULL)
+        manager.rank_port = manager.server_socket.bind_to_random_port("tcp://127.0.0.1")
+        manager.connection_pool = {}
+        manager.connection_lock = threading.Lock()
+        manager._socket_cache = {}
+        manager._monitor_cache = {}
+        manager._socket_send_locks = {}
+        manager._socket_lock = threading.Lock()
+        manager._peer_cache_condition = threading.Condition()
+        manager._peer_cache_request_id = None
+        manager._peer_cache_pending = set()
+        manager._retired_decode_peers = set()
+        manager.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.DECODE
+        manager.defer_decode_allocation = False
+        return manager
+
+    def _listen(self, manager, *, duplicate=False, stale_ack=False):
+        stop = threading.Event()
+
+        def receive():
+            while not stop.is_set():
+                if not manager.server_socket.poll(20):
+                    continue
+                msg = manager.server_socket.recv_multipart()
+                invalidation = msg[0] == b"PEER_CACHE_INVALIDATE"
+                if stale_ack and invalidation:
+                    msg[1] = b"previous-switch"
+                manager.handle_peer_cache_invalidation(msg)
+                if duplicate and invalidation:
+                    manager.handle_peer_cache_invalidation(msg)
+
+        worker = threading.Thread(target=receive)
+        worker.start()
+
+        def cleanup():
+            stop.set()
+            worker.join(2)
+
+        self.addCleanup(cleanup)
+
+    def test_worker_notification_invalidates_peer_and_reregisters_once(self):
+        prefill, decode, empty_decode = [self._transport_manager() for _ in range(3)]
+        prefill.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+        self._listen(prefill)
+        endpoint = f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{prefill.rank_port}"
+        CommonKVReceiver._connect(endpoint)
+        self.addCleanup(CommonKVReceiver.close_all_sockets)
+        old = [{"rank_ip": "127.0.0.1", "rank_port": prefill.rank_port}]
+        other = [{"rank_ip": "127.0.0.1", "rank_port": prefill.rank_port + 1}]
+        decode.connection_pool = {
+            "prefill:8998_0_0_0": old,
+            "alias:8998_0_0_0": old,
+            "other": other,
+        }
+        decode.request_status = {1: KVPoll.Success, 2: KVPoll.WaitingForInput}
+        prefill.decode_kv_args_table = {
+            name: SimpleNamespace(endpoint="127.0.0.1", dst_port=peer.rank_port)
+            for name, peer in (
+                ("one", decode),
+                ("duplicate", decode),
+                ("two", empty_decode),
+            )
+        }
+        self._listen(decode)
+        self._listen(empty_decode)
+        prefill.notify_role_switch_peers(timeout=1)
+        self.assertNotIn(endpoint, CommonKVReceiver._socket_cache)
+        self.assertEqual(decode.connection_pool, {"other": other})
+        self.assertEqual(
+            decode.request_status, {1: KVPoll.Success, 2: KVPoll.WaitingForInput}
+        )
+
+        # Re-register even if the rebuilt P reuses its old port. Later requests

+        receiver._get_bootstrap_info_from_server = Mock(return_value=dict(old[0]))
+        receiver._register_kv_args = Mock(return_value=True)
